exceptions.unsupportedBehavior: CSS keyword letter spacing is not a React Native numeric value.
exceptions.fallback: Use 0 unless the platform typography owner supplies a measured numeric override.

exceptions.unsupportedBehavior: CSS cubic-bezier strings are not directly accepted by React Native animation drivers.
exceptions.fallback: Map the semantic role to the platform animation driver's equivalent easing function.

exceptions.unsupportedBehavior: CSS multi-shadow expressions do not map one-to-one to iOS and Android elevation APIs.
exceptions.fallback: Use the documented platform shadow recipe for the same semantic elevation role.

exceptions.unsupportedBehavior: Modern CSS relative rgb syntax requires platform color normalization.
exceptions.fallback: Resolve the active neutral color and apply the documented alpha on the native platform.
